note: Graveborn Grave Reaper (unit identity, Graveborn): tall bone wraith, biped, a deep black hood with the skull deep inside and two soul-light eyes, a grave-iron mantle over a cuirass, a team sash, torn shroud and rags hemmed in violet, bare bone limbs, a scythe whose 10 px blade rises over the hood. Tier II iron plate, tier III black gilt plate and a crown of tines. No flag on the back.
